votes.motion: A motion was made by Zach Robinson, seconded by Ryan Mecham, to approve the Consent Calendar

A motion was made by Zach Robinson, seconded by Ryan Mecham, to adopt Ordinance 23-05, an ordinance amending and fixing the boundaries of a zone district of the Sandy City Zoning Ordinance; rezoning approximately 2.5 acres, involving one parcel, as proposed by the Applicant, generally located at 963 E. 8600 S. from the R-1-8 Zone ("Single Family Residential District") to the SD(R-1-7) Zone ("Single Family Residential in a Special Development District")
A motion was made by Zach Robinson, seconded by Ryan Mecham to recess the City Council meeting, and convene a meeting of the Redevelopment Board of Sandy City
A motion was made by Zach Robinson, seconded by Ryan Mecham to convene a closed session in the Council Conference Room, and adjourn the Council meeting immediately following the closed session
